items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Our band has been playing — with Dick Sherman’s band — at the Donnell Library

ctx.x: You’ve managed to keep playing. Do you have a steady gig?

Yeah actually I’m very lucky. I have two steady gigs. Our band has been playing — with Dick Sherman’s band — at the Donnell Library which is over here on 53rd Street, a half a block from here. We’ve been playing there since 1976 every Thursday 12:30 ‘till 2:00 and off for the summers but we’ve been there all that time. And we have a nice crowd that comes it. It’s a beautiful little auditorium, one of the nicest auditoriums, small auditoriums in New York. The acoustics are marvelous. And they have a great big…
It’s like a lunchtime sort of concert?
